text:
maria: Hey — running through the quickstart on my M1 Mac and hit a weird TLS error during `redwoodctl login --headless` after brew install.

samir: ugh, what error?

maria: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` when the browser callback tries to reach the local callback URL. Looks like our dev machine is behind a corp proxy that injects a cert.

jen: is HTTP(S)_PROXY set? redwoodctl should pick it up.

maria: HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY set, yes. `curl https://callback.local:12345` works if I pass `--cacert /etc/ssl/corp-root.pem` but redwoodctl doesn't seem to accept a CA path.

samir: redwoodctl uses Go tls by default which respects system roots, but not custom env CA files. We have a ticket for `--cacert` flag but not shipped.

maria: ok — any workaround to get the quickstart working? localtest server never sees the auth callback because the client fails TLS handshake.

jen: two options: 1) add corp-root to macOS system keychain (sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /path/to/corp-root.pem) or 2) run redwoodctl with `GODEBUG=x509ignoreCN=0`? not ideal.

maria: Adding to keychain worked, thanks. But this feels rough for onboarding — we had a bunch of users in the quickstart who aren't comfortable messing with keychains.

samir: Agreed. DX problem: install + corporate proxy + headless login = high friction. We should detect proxy cert chain and surface clearer guidance in `redwoodctl doctor` and the quickstart docs.

jen: Also noticed on the sample app the config profile that quickstart creates (`~/.redwood/profiles/default`) stores `auth: headless` and `callback_url: http://localhost:12345`. When TLS fails the CLI retries quickly and spams the auth server logs. Maybe exponential backoff?

maria: The retries produce confusing errors for end users: they see `login failed: tls: handshake error` repeated and then the login token times out.

samir: Two small fixes we can do fast: 1) Make retry backoff visible and slower (2 retries, backoff 2s -> 8s) and 2) add a friendly hint when x509 unknown authority is detected: "If you're on a corporate network with SSL inspection, add your corp CA to system trusts or run in an environment without the proxy."

jen: Can we auto-detect common env vars like SSL_CERT_FILE and if present, warn that redwoodctl doesn't read it?

samir: yep. Also add an explicit check at startup: attempt a TLS GET to the callback host and if cert chain fails capture the error and return a help link.

maria: Another oddity: on Homebrew install the postinstall echoes an instruction to run `redwoodctl init` but it doesn't mention the `--profile` flag. Our sample app expects `quickstart` profile. New users ended up with `default` and then env var overlap.

jen: Yeah we should update the installer message: "run `redwoodctl init --profile quickstart` to create the sample app profile". Also make `redwoodctl init` interactive by default and show a one-line summary of created files.

ci-bot: deploy-check: lint passed on docs patch branch `devex/proxy-cert-help`

maria: Last thing — localtest server binds to 127.0.0.1 by default; if dev uses Docker w/ host networking the callback may be reachable but cert mismatch occurs because the cert is for internal proxy host. Maybe we should allow `--insecure-local-callback` for dev and clearly mark it unsafe?

samir: I'd rather avoid flags that encourage insecure behavior. Instead add `--local-callback-host` to override callback host and port (defaults to 127.0.0.1:12345) and accept `--trust-local-ca /path/to/ca.pem` to load additional CA for the headless flow only.

jen: `--trust-local-ca` is a good compromise — explicitly scoped and documented as dev-only. Make sure we don't persist that CA into the user's main system trust store.

maria: Sounds good. I'll open a ticket with the quick fixes and a follow-up for the longer-term installer UX improvements. Will paste notes and stack traces.

samir: thanks — assign to devex, tag `redwoodctl`, and cc eng-ml for visibility (they also hit proxy certs during model download).

maria: filing now. Patch idea included for doctor command and the quickstart docs.

jen: thanks! :raised_hands:"
